title: File-backed monotonic counter under lock with fsync
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might worry the lock is released by closing or that replacing the counter file loses the lock. The lock is held on a separate, never-replaced lock file for the whole read-increment-replace sequence, so serialisation survives the atomic rename of the data file.
